name: set_object_animation_speed

stack.evidence: func_001D40F0 resolves the top object ID, divides the preceding speed value by 100, passes that float to func_00131B40, and decrements Script stackTop by two

notes: func_00131B40 stores the scaled value at object offset 0x284. The motion update multiplies its frame advance by that field, establishing it as the animation-speed multiplier. Representative al01.ard calls set object 2 to 90 percent before an animation wait and restore it to 100 percent afterward.
